source.rationale:
TWIN CONTRACT. dym-transform and dym-transform-partial are byte-identical apart from the `promotion` DOMAIN_PROBE entry (and two comment rules), so every behaviour that is not promotion-specific MUST hold identically on both. Ported deliberately rather than left to the twin: this repo has been bitten before by a fork asserted to be identical that had quietly drifted, and a rule proven on only one copy is a rule the other copy is free to lose. Same inputs, same expected output as dym-transform/HC-picker-lane-uses-the-gates-own-option-set.json — if the two ever disagree, one of these two fixtures fails.

Behaviour under test: The require-specific numbered picker's candidates are NOT D1 survivors — D1 is suppressed on those turns, which is why the surface stayed bare while D1 annotated the very same codes. They are the gate's own already-uuid-carrying option set, and the lane must be stamped `picker` so downstream can tell which surface it is annotating.
